obfuscation_indicators: no reasonable estimate of possible loss
risk_summary: The disclosure is heavily weighted toward standard forward-looking and legal disclaimers, with limited quantified discussion of future performance beyond a mid-single-digit revenue growth expectation. Litigation exposure is material and the company states it cannot estimate potential losses, while related-party transactions and non-arm’s-length arrangements add governance risk. Operating performance improved in 2011 but remained below expectations following the 2008–2010 downturn.
